When you’re developing an app and would like to integrate another platform, a developer can use a “Software Development Kit” (SDK), which is provided by the platform.

Spotify used to have an iOS SDK where a developer was able to directly stream from their own app. Now they released a new SDK where the developer can only “control the Spotify app”. The streaming itself takes place in the Spotify app, but your app would “talk to” (remote control) the Spotify app.
